summary_en: Year-end dividend for fiscal year 2026 raised by 10 yen per share to 19 yen, bringing annual dividend to 28 yen per share. The increase follows upward revision of full-year operating profit to 3,050 million yen from 2,600 million yen, driven by stronger-than-expected recurring revenue and lower operating expenses.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast (Upward Revision) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Segue Group revised its fiscal year 2026 dividend forecast upward on November 12, 2026, increasing the year-end dividend by 10 yen per share to 19 yen. The full-year dividend is now expected to be 28 yen per share, compared to the previous forecast of 18 yen. This adjustment reflects an upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings announced earlier. The company now projects net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 1,950 million yen, up 21.9% from the previous forecast of 1,600 million yen.

The profit increase was driven by stronger-than-expected performance in the third quarter and year-to-date results. Recurring revenue from support services and sales of the company's proprietary product "RevoWorks" to government agencies and local authorities exceeded initial expectations. Additionally, selling, general, and administrative expenses came in below projections. For the fourth quarter, the company anticipates continued solid performance in network and security product orders and recurring revenue streams, though it conservatively factors in potential delivery delays for imported products due to semiconductor supply issues and growth investments related to planned M&A activities.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's stated basic policy of distributing dividends targeting a 50% payout ratio based on net income attributable to parent company shareholders. The company positions shareholder returns as a key management priority.
